about_the_game:
WRONG HOUSE – Multiplayer First-Person Survival Horror

You thought it would be an easy score—break into an abandoned mansion, grab some loot, and get out. But this is no ordinary break-in. This haunted house has a dark past… and something inside has been waiting for you.

In WRONG HOUSE, a terrifying first-person survival horror game, you take on the role of a daring thief searching for valuable treasures inside a sprawling, abandoned and haunted mansion. The corridors are pitch-black, the air is heavy, and every creak of the floorboards could be your last. Multiple ghosts and monsters roam the estate, each with unique behaviors and hunting styles, forcing you to adapt if you want to survive.

Key Features:

  • First-Person Survival Horror: Immersive gameplay set in a creepy, abandoned mansion filled with supernatural threats.

  • Singleplayer & Multiplayer Co-Op: Face the horror alone or with friends in online co-op multiplayer.

  • Randomized Loot & Encounters: Valuable items spawn in different locations each run, creating endless replayability.

  • Variety of Supernatural Enemies: Each ghost or monster hunts you in its own unique way.

  • High-Stakes Permadeath: One wrong move and it’s over — the game restarts, loot reshuffles, and the nightmare begins again.

  • Atmospheric Horror Experience: Dark rooms, tense sound design, and unpredictable dangers keep you on edge.

The mansion won’t give up its treasures without a fight. Will you escape with the loot… or join the countless souls lost within its walls?
